name: Railway MCP
tagline: Manage Railway projects, services, and databases from chat.
shortDescription: The Railway MCP server. List projects, deploy services, manage environment variables, view logs, manage databases (Postgres, MySQL, Redis), and inspect usage. The simplest platform for indie devs.
longDescription:
## What it is

The Railway MCP server. Exposes the Railway API as MCP tools: list projects, deploy services, manage env vars, view logs, manage databases, and inspect usage/billing.

## Why we recommend it

Railway is the easiest platform to deploy a side project. The MCP server lets your agent do everything you can do in the dashboard, conversationally.

## When to use it

- Deploys: agent triggers a deploy, monitors the build, reports the URL
- Env vars: agent adds/rotates secrets
- Databases: agent provisions Postgres/Redis, runs migrations
- Logs: agent pulls the latest logs for a service
installInstructions:
1. Get a Railway API token at https://railway.app/account/tokens
2. Set `RAILWAY_TOKEN=...`
3. `npx -y @railway/mcp`

**Hobby plan:** $5/month plus usage. Generous free trial.
pricingDetails: Free. The MCP server is open source. Railway: $5/month hobby plan plus usage-based pricing.
